card.name: Second digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: The second digit (often 0 or 6, sometimes 5) inside a two- or three-digit number. It is most common in storage temperatures such as 36°F to 46°F or 20°C to 25°C, and also in percentages and ranges.

modes.label: Storage temperatures
modes.description: Last digit of the first number in a temperature range, just before the degree sign.

modes.label: Percentages and ranges
modes.description: Digit inside a percentage, confidence interval or age range.
